in_marathi.name: Krushna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dark, Black, or All-Attracting
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krushna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Krushna is the eighth avatar of the god Vishnu. Born to destroy the demon king Kamsa, Krushna is known for his strength, mischievousness, and love for butter. He is often depicted as a dark-skinned, all-attracting, and all-powerful deity.
